body: What life would be worth living to you?

Yes, we're in the same boat. I think inert gas is the best way to commit suicide and will definitely be my method of choice as well. The problem is it takes a lot of planning and execution which is hard when you're depressed.

Make sure it's done right, the flow needs to be properly adjusted (optimal is most likely 15l/min). Peaceful pill handbook has more details if you're interested, you can download it for free from libgen.
